paper_title: Knowledge Crosswords Geometric Knowledge Reasoning with Large Language   Models
caption: Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of categories labeled as "easy," "medium," and "hard" in a Zero-Shot context, using pie charts to represent various segments. There are four slices in each pie chart. For the "easy" chart, the slices are labeled as: "N+K+" in teal (55.4%), "N−K+" in yellow (38.3%), "N−K−" in orange (4.6%), and "N+K−" in red (1.7%). The "medium" chart contains "N+K+" in teal (58.8%), "N−K+" in yellow (35.4%), "N−K−" in orange (4.0%), and "N+K−" in red (1.8%). The "hard" chart includes "N+K+" in teal (18.1%), "N−K+" in yellow (37.3%), "N−K−" in orange (37.9%), and "N+K−" in red (6.7%). A legend is provided to identify the colors and their corresponding labels. Each slice within the charts is labeled with its respective percentage, but no slices are visually emphasized such as being exploded or offset. The segments do not appear to be ordered in a particular way, such as by descending size.
